parameters.query: UPDATE leads.discovery_runs SET status = 'failed', finished_at = now(), error = $1 WHERE status = 'running' RETURNING id

parameters.subject: ={{ 'AUTOMATION ERROR: ' + ($('On Workflow Error').item.json.workflow?.name ?? 'unknown workflow') }}
parameters.text:
={{ 'A lead-gen automation failed and may need attention.

Workflow: ' + ($('On Workflow Error').item.json.workflow?.name ?? '?') + '
Failed node: ' + ($('On Workflow Error').item.json.execution?.error?.lastNodeExecuted ?? $('On Workflow Error').item.json.execution?.error?.node?.name ?? ($('On Workflow Error').item.json.trigger ? '(trigger activation)' : '?')) + '
Error: ' + ($('On Workflow Error').item.json.execution?.error?.message ?? $('On Workflow Error').item.json.trigger?.error?.message ?? '?') + '
Execution: ' + ($('On Workflow Error').item.json.execution?.id ?? '?') + '
Time: ' + $now.toISO() + '

Open n8n executions to inspect: https://n8n.kqualitycleaningservices.com.au/executions' }}

parameters.query:
INSERT INTO leads.notifications (type, candidate_id, title, message, severity)
SELECT 'workflow_failure', NULL, $1, $2, $3 WHERE $3 <> 'suppress'

options.queryReplacement: ={{ [ ($('On Workflow Error').item.json.workflow?.name ?? 'unknown workflow'), ($('On Workflow Error').item.json.execution?.error?.lastNodeExecuted ?? $('On Workflow Error').item.json.execution?.error?.node?.name ?? ($('On Workflow Error').item.json.trigger ? '(trigger)' : 'unknown node')) + ': ' + ($('On Workflow Error').item.json.execution?.error?.message ?? $('On Workflow Error').item.json.trigger?.error?.message ?? 'unknown error') + ' (execution ' + ($('On Workflow Error').item.json.execution?.id ?? '?') + ')', (($('On Workflow Error').item.json.trigger && /IMAP|automatically retry reactivating/i.test(String($('On Workflow Error').item.json.trigger?.error?.message ?? '') + ' ' + String($('On Workflow Error').item.json.trigger?.error?.description ?? ''))) ? 'suppress' : 'error') ] }}
